note: Private campground 3 miles off I-80 (exit 19), on the Hennepin Canal State Trail: RV loops are set back from the canal behind trees and the towpath. Kayak, canoe and e-bike rentals; LP fill, playground. --Claude
summary: Operator site and its rol.camp booking engine read: 71 sites (62 RV units 40-68 ft, 6 van, 3 tent), FHU 30/50 A and W/E 30 A; 2026 base rates $48 (W/E) / $56 (30 A FHU) / $62 (50 A FHU), same in July 2027; open year-round with limited winter sites; showers, laundry, dump, store, wifi. Google 4.6/529. Cheapest RV site $48 passes the $50 gate; full-hookup sites over it. No gateway, not a Good Sam Park. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PRICE GATE (private): rate now known (none stored). Cheapest RV class $48/night (30 A water/electric, 22 sites, 19 bookable online) is under $50; full-hookup classes $56 and $62 are over. Not a Good Sam Park (stored false), no gateway within 40 km (gateways.py), no member discount posted. Passes on the water/electric class; reviewer may weigh that the full-hookup sites exceed $50.

LONG-STAY five tests: (1) no seasonal or monthly sites marketed; (2) every unit type carries a nightly rate; (3) no lots for sale; (4) reviews describe nights and weekends; (5) no 'call for availability' wording ('we accept same day reservations until 6pm'). Nightly share: all 71 units are sold by the night; 53 of 71 (44 of 62 RV units) are flagged bookable online, the rest presumably by phone. Not long-stay in character.
PHONE: stored 309-442-2662 matches the operator's site (header, footer, rates page); Google lists 309-944-6465. No change.
